display_title: The Young Master Hides His Chest

titles_en.title: The Young Master Hides His Chest

description:
She has a childhood friend, Do Ryun-Nim, who habitually proposed to her when she was young… It is true that she liked the kind, pitiful, and intelligent Do Ryun-Nim, but Hazel, as an adult, had long since figured out the main point. Do Ryun-Nim is the youngest son of a duke’s family, and I am the young lady of a baron’s family in name only. So there will be no marriage in this life. I will live my life with the sole goal of admiring the physical beauty of men in public places (fighting arenas) and touching the chest of the royal family man. I returned home with that promise. “So, it’s not like this, Do Ryun-Nim… Huh?” As if to drive home the fact that you are no longer my ideal type, the moment she lightly touched Do Ryun-Nim’s weak chest. 

*“…Why is it like this?”

“Heez, I’m sorry. Are you mad? Do you want to touch my chest?”*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes one prologue.*
